title: DECSET 1036 — Send ESC when Meta modifies a key
summary: CSI ? 1036 h enables sending ESC before a key when Meta (Alt) is held. CSI ? 1036 l disables it.

frame.note: DEC private modes are CSI sequences with a leading '?' (0x3F) private-parameter prefix. Set = final byte 'h' (DECSET); reset = final byte 'l' (DECRST).

terminator_detail.note: No string terminator: a DEC private mode is a CSI sequence ending at its final byte ('h' to set, 'l' to reset).

params.name: Enable (DECSET)
params.meaning: CSI ? 1036 h Meta sends ESC prefix

gotchas: When enabled, Alt+key sends ESC followed by the key.
When disabled, Alt+key may send a modified character (e.g., in UTF-8).
This affects how terminal applications receive Alt key presses.

v1_smoke_test.asserts: DECSET/DECRST 1036 render as byte-exact CSI ? 1036 h/l sequences.
